item.text: {"text":"HSTU’s useful instrumentation points follow its actual computation: U/V/Q/K projections, non-softmax SiLU attention, aggregated values, normalized aggregation × U gating, output projection, and residual addition ([original paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.17152), [reference implementation](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/generative_recommenders/research/modeling/sequential/hstu.py)). Practical adaptation: hook these tensors in the fitted model; record gate distributions, branch norms and candidate-score changes under interventions. Gate magnitudes and attention weights describe activity, but cannot establish causal importance. Residual norms also require intervention checks because downstream normalization and nonlinearities alter their effects.\n\nActivation-patching research shows that corruption choice, patch direction and scoring metric can materially change conclusions; natural replacement inputs and score differences offer useful starting points ([ICLR 2024 study](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/file/06a52a54c8ee03cd86771136bc91eb1f-Paper-Conference.pdf), [interpretation guide](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.15255)). Proposed HSTU adaptation: keep sequence length, padding, positions and final-item readout fixed; compare matched histories differing only in prefix, then separately replace the final item. Patch gates, aggregation outputs and residual updates between paired runs, testing both restoration and disruption. Require identity patches to reproduce baseline scores, verify the replacement tensor actually reached its intended site, and check untouched activations remain unchanged upstream. Measure fixed-candidate target-versus-negative score margins alongside rank changes; report raw effects when normalized recovery has a near-zero denominator. Attribution patching can screen sites cheaply, but its local linear approximation needs exact-patching confirmation ([method explanation](https://www.neelnanda.io/mechanistic-interpretability/attribution-patching)). These are diagnostic proposals using the existing network, not established HSTU-specific findings or auxiliary predictors."}
